reviewCenters.name: Pioneer Review Center Inc. (PRCI)

examInfo.title: Eligibility pathways
examInfo.body: ASCP BOC offers multiple eligibility routes for international MLS candidates. Check the official Eligibility Assistant on the ASCP website. We do not reproduce specific requirements here because they change — always verify on the official site.

examInfo.title: Application & scheduling
examInfo.body: The application is completed through ASCP BOC, with exam delivery at Pearson VUE test centers. Follow the official process on the ASCP website.

examInfo.title: Exam format overview
examInfo.body: The MLS examination is computer-adaptive. This app's adaptive practice mode is NOT the ASCP CAT, and practice scores are not ASCP scores.

disclaimer: MedTech Review Hub is an independent study platform and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by ASCP or any review center listed here. Fees, schedules, and program inclusions are taken from providers' public websites as of November 2026 and may change — confirm directly with the provider. Official ASCP BOC requirements change over time; always verify on the official ASCP website.
